content.comment_body: Hello, In [product_name] you can define network inputs linked to local variable memory, but it’s challenging to keep track of which variable memory is already assigned in a diagram. Is there a way to query a list of used local variable memory? Under the main menu 'Tools / Parameter Vm mapping', there’s a tool for VM configuration, but it shows the VM mapping for assigned function blocks only—not the assigned local variable memory. What’s the recommended method for tracking local variable memory assignments?
In [product_name], there isn’t a reference feature like in other [company_name] software. The closest option is: Edit > Block properties (all blocks).
Thanks for your answer. So, we need to manually review each network input block and note the VM location used, keeping track of this information in an external file such as a spreadsheet.
Yes, that's correct. Otherwise, it can be easy to lose track of assignments.

Hello, You can see what you have set up via VM-Mapping if you go to Print preview (File/Print preview). This view also shows which NI, NQ, NAI, and NAQ elements are used in your application. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties managing local variable memory assignments in [product_name], as the available VM mapping tool does not display all details, requiring manual checks and external documentation. There is interest in a feature that provides a comprehensive, centralized overview similar to solutions found in other automation software, indicating manual work remains necessary.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an integrated function in [product_name] to display all local variable memory assignments within the software itself, similar to reference features available in other automation platforms.
